queue.title: Disable SSH password authentication
queue.lynis_evidence: Baseline confirms passwordauthentication=yes; Lynis SSH-7408 present
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: An attacker with network reach to SSH can attempt password-based brute force against any of the 4 real accounts

queue.title: Disable direct SSH root login
queue.lynis_evidence: Baseline confirms permitrootlogin=yes; Lynis SSH-7408 present
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: Root-level SSH access possible without individual account attribution

queue.title: Deploy auditd rules for privilege escalation and sensitive file modification
queue.lynis_evidence: Lynis ACCT-9630 directly confirms: audit daemon is enabled with an empty ruleset
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: auditd is running but capturing nothing; a privilege escalation or credential theft attempt would leave no audit trail whatsoever
queue.expected_validation_check: auditctl -l lists rules watching /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, and sudo execution

queue.title: Restrict core dumps (fs.suid_dumpable=0)
queue.lynis_evidence: Baseline confirms fs.suid_dumpable=2 (should be 0); Lynis KRNL-5820 present
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: A process crash could expose credentials or session data resident in memory to any local user

queue.title: Identify and remove unauthorized SUID binaries
queue.lynis_evidence: Baseline confirms 2 non-standard SUID binaries outside typical package paths (/usr/local, /opt)
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: An unexplained SUID binary on a previously compromised server (0x00 cryptominer incident) may itself be a persistence mechanism
queue.expected_validation_check: SUID list cross-referenced against Task 0 baseline contains zero unexplained entries

queue.title: Restrict MySQL to localhost-only binding and enforce default-deny host firewall
queue.lynis_evidence: Baseline confirms MySQL bound to 0.0.0.0:3306; Lynis FIRE-4512 confirms iptables loaded with no active rules; FIRE-4513 confirms unused rule review needed
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: The patient database is reachable from any network address with no host firewall enforcing restriction, the same exfiltration method documented in the Crimson Tide advisory
queue.expected_validation_check: ss -tulnH shows 3306 bound to 127.0.0.1 only, and ufw status shows default deny incoming

queue.title: Restrict SSH access to an explicit allowed-users list
queue.lynis_evidence: Lynis SSH-7408 present (generic SSH hardening); baseline shows allowusers=not-set
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: Any valid credential on the system can authenticate over SSH, not only approved administrative accounts
queue.expected_validation_check: sshd -T | grep -i allowusers lists only approved accounts

queue.title: Disable IP forwarding
queue.lynis_evidence: Baseline confirms net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 on a database/web server with no routing function
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: A compromised host could be repurposed as an internal network pivot

queue.title: Apply noexec, nosuid, and nodev mount options to non-system partitions
queue.lynis_evidence: No baseline or Lynis confirmation exists; evidence basis is documented Ubuntu 22.04 default behavior (these mount options are not applied out of the box), not scan data
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: Partitions that should never execute code currently can, widening post-exploitation persistence options
queue.expected_validation_check: mount | grep <partition> shows noexec,nosuid,nodev where applicable

queue.title: Configure remote log forwarding and enforce log file write-protection
queue.lynis_evidence: Lynis LOGG-2154 directly confirms: no external logging host currently configured
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: If any of these three servers, especially log-srv-01, is compromised, an attacker can erase local evidence with no off-host copy surviving
queue.expected_validation_check: rsyslog.conf shows a configured remote receiver, and local log files carry append-only protection

queue.title: Disable or remove unnecessary network-facing services
queue.lynis_evidence: Baseline confirms 28 running services on billing-srv-01; no formal approved-services allow-list exists to confirm which are justified
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: Unreviewed running services represent unmeasured, unjustified attack surface on a server with a prior confirmed compromise
queue.expected_validation_check: systemctl list-units --state=running count decreases and matches an approved services allow-list

queue.title: Enforce password quality requirements via pam_pwquality
queue.lynis_evidence: Lynis flags adjacent password-policy items (AUTH-9230/9282/9286/9328), not the pwquality module specifically
queue.operational_risk_if_unresolved: Weak passwords may currently be accepted, though the exact pwquality module state is not directly confirmed
queue.expected_validation_check: grep pam_pwquality /etc/pam.d/common-password shows minlen and complexity requirements
